definitions.explanation: Strong criticism directed at someone's actions, decisions, or behavior, typically on moral or ethical grounds. Stronger and more accusatory than {批判|ひはん}, implying that the target has done something wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{非難|ひなん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無責任|むせきにん}→無責任：13474_musekinin⟧な⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{非難|ひなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びた→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧。
examples.english: His irresponsible remarks drew public censure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{破壊|はかい}→環境破壊：15957_kankyouhakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧、{国際社会|こくさいしゃかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{非難|ひなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Harsh criticism from the international community is being directed at companies that continue to destroy the environment.

notes:
USAGE:
{非難|ひなん} implies moral or ethical fault-finding and is stronger than ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧, which can be more analytical or constructive. {非難|ひなん} suggests the speaker believes the target has done something wrong.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非難|ひなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧ (to be showered with criticism)
- {非難|ひなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (voices of criticism)
- {非難|ひなん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to criticize, to condemn)
- {非難|ひなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive criticism)
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{非難|ひなん} (harsh criticism)
- {非難|ひなん}{合戦|がっせん} (war of words; exchange of accusations)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧ (evacuation), which has the same reading but completely different meaning and kanji.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {非難|ひなん}: criticism, censure (moral fault-finding; accusatory)
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧: criticism (can be analytical or constructive)
- ⟦{糾弾|きゅうだん}→糾弾：07890_kyuudan⟧: denunciation (even stronger; formal accusation)
- ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧: evacuation (different word, same reading)
